## POST `/api/instances/iscsiSettings/{id}/action/modify`

**Tier:** T1–T3 (action: read its description)  

Modify ISCSI settings. For ASCII secret type, the secret must be 12 to 16 characters long and accepts any ASCII character. For Binary secret type, the secret is 24 to 32 characters long and accepts all hexadecimal characters. Username must be alphanumeric.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string | yes | Unique instance identifier. This is a singleton resource, so the id is always 0. |

_4 parameter(s) have no name in the source spec and are omitted._

**Request body** (required): `inline`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `reverseCHAPUsername` | string | Reverse CHAP user name. Put empty string to disable reverse CHAP. |
| `reverseCHAPSecret` | string | Reverse CHAP secret. Ignored if reverseCHAPUsername is empty. |
| `reverseCHAPSecretType` | `CHAPSecretTypeEnum` | CHAP secret type. \|Name\|Value\|Description\| \|----------\|----------\|----------\| \|Binary\|0\|CHAP secret is binary.\| \|ASCII\|1\|CHAP secret is ASCII.\| |
| `isForwardCHAPRequired` | boolean | True if CHAP auth is required for initiators. |
| `forwardGlobalCHAPUsername` | string | Global CHAP user name. Put empty string to disable global CHAP. |
| `forwardGlobalCHAPSecret` | string | Global CHAP secret. Ignored if forwardGlobalCHAPUsername is empty. |
| `forwardGlobalCHAPSecretType` | `CHAPSecretTypeEnum` | CHAP secret type. \|Name\|Value\|Description\| \|----------\|----------\|----------\| \|Binary\|0\|CHAP secret is binary.\| \|ASCII\|1\|CHAP secret is ASCII.\| |
| `iSNSServer` | string (IPv6 supported: true, Prefix-length supported: false, Port supported: false, DNS name supported: false) | iSNS server IP address. Empty string to unset. |

**Responses:** `204` No Content
